message: feat(extensions): add Jura Tempest and Mangtto extensions

files.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <application
        android:label="Tachiyomi: Jura Tempest"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher">
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.class"
            android:value="eu.kanade.tachiyomi.extension.tr.juratempest.JuraTempest" />
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.version"
            android:value="1.4.1" />
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.nsfw"
            android:value="0" />
    </application>
</manifest>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <application
        android:label="Tachiyomi: Mangtto"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher">
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.class"
            android:value="eu.kanade.tachiyomi.extension.tr.mangtto.Mangtto" />
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.version"
            android:value="1.4.1" />
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.nsfw"
            android:value="0" />
    </application>
</manifest>
